title: Specify post.published audience for non-public posts
description: 16-interop-streams Ch 49 does not say whether post.published is emitted for followers-only/limited posts or to whom. Corundum is public-conversation scoped (Ch 40), but reply policies (followers-only) exist. Decide: stream carries only public posts, or define audience filtering.
close_reason: Decided (Mark 2026-10-18): every activity is public (to MUST include as:Public; Ch 11); reply policies limit replies, not readers; post.published emitted for every activity.
